Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Do not take sertraline with a monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI), or within 14 days of stopping one, because of the risk of serotonin syndrome. This includes the antibiotic linezolid and intravenous methylene blue. You also need to wait at least 14 days after stopping sertraline before starting an MAOI.
Do not take sertraline with pimozide, an antipsychotic medicine. Do not take sertraline oral solution if you take disulfiram (Antabuse), because the solution contains alcohol.
Sertraline can raise the risk of bleeding, particularly if you also take aspirin, NSAIDs such as ibuprofen or naproxen, other antiplatelet medicines, warfarin, or other anticoagulants.
Screening for a personal or family history of bipolar disorder, mania, or hypomania is recommended before starting sertraline, since treating a depressive episode with an antidepressant can trigger a manic episode in someone with bipolar disorder.
Do not stop taking sertraline suddenly. Adverse reactions can occur when it is stopped, especially when it is stopped abruptly, so the dose should be lowered gradually where possible.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "requires screening for", "hypomania"]

The relation 'requires screening for' in the triplet is defined as 'Before initiating treatment with the subject drug, screening for the specified medical condition or history is recommended to prevent adverse outcomes.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. B. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
C. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
D. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
E. 'should inform doctor about': Patients taking the subject drug should tell their doctor about the condition or circumstance specified by the object entity.
